title: crypto-js is deprecated
summary: npm marks crypto-js as deprecated: "Active development of CryptoJS has been discontinued. This library is no longer maintained."
replacement: Web Crypto API (globalThis.crypto.subtle) or a maintained cryptography library

constraints: Preserve the algorithms, modes, padding, key derivation, and output encodings each call site relies on, so data encrypted before the change still decrypts afterwards.

steps.title: Audit every cryptographic call
steps.instructions: List each hash, cipher, KDF, HMAC, and encoding call with its algorithm, mode, padding, IV, and key size.

steps.title: Reimplement with a maintained implementation
steps.instructions: Replace each call with the Web Crypto API or a maintained library that supports the same algorithms and parameters.

steps.title: Remove crypto-js
steps.instructions: Remove crypto-js from dependencies and the lockfile once no call sites remain.

verification.purpose: Round-trip existing ciphertext and compare known-answer vectors in the repository tests.
Type-check and build every affected entry point.
